scope: two physical hosts, production CLI, real tailcat; no system clipboard
checks: matching production binaries transferred and verified; no UI dependency
isolated headless daemons run on macOS and Windows
unpaired submission commits locally with no_targets
fingerprints match; no transmission before mutual approval
mutual CLI approval establishes real two-host tailcat connection
UTF-8 content verified; concurrent retries deduplicate; changed input conflicts; receive tags remain local
capture processor preserves local content, tags and expiry while blocking sync
sync.enabled: local commit succeeds, remote blocked, no replay on enable
plugins.instances."builtin.tailcat".sync.text: local commit succeeds, remote blocked, no replay on enable
bidirectional size matrix: every sample exported and SHA256 verified
completed matrix daemon logs are empty: no content, address or ticket output
same matrix profiles preserve identities, trust and every history ID across restart
new bidirectional content transfers and exports correctly after restart
revocation blocks later remote content while local commit succeeds
latency_definition: controller monotonic time before submit until receiver history export SHA256 verification; includes CLI, SSH, polling, export and hashing; not pure network latency
limits: HTML/rich-text submission is not exposed by the production CLI
native capture/application and echo are not exercised
in-flight queue replacement, slow observers and cancellation races require separate acceptance

clock_probe.method: 12 request/response timestamps over one persistent SSH stream; smallest half RTT bounds offset uncertainty

recovery.prior_failure: external command failed (details kept out of manifest)
recovery.reason: Windows active redirect files prevented log reading; matrix had completed. Closure resumes only after verifying the same source, binaries and isolated state.

source_verification.basis: frozen worktree matches every recorded production-source SHA256
source_verification.limit: macOS unicd rebuild is not byte-identical; the actual tested binary hash remains authoritative. Do not claim a fully reproducible macOS service binary.
